title: I made a gardening roguelike!
author: SproutAndSesame
selftext:
Here's Arborist!

Think of your favorite roguelike deckbuilders with lots of card variety and replayability, except instead of fighting monsters, you're building a garden beautiful enough to attract rare birds.

I'm a solo developer, and I've used AI across the game's art to help me make way more plants, birds, animals, and other assets than I could've managed on my own (550 images so far).

I spent the past six months working on this and the Steam page just went live! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5250680/Arborist/

comments.author: Grand-Astronaut-7675
comments.body: How long did this take you??

replies.author: SproutAndSesame
replies.body: It's been 6 months since I've started! I'll be publishing a demo for it shortly :)

comments.author: Famous-Necessary1796
comments.body: This reminds me of slay the spire

replies.author: SproutAndSesame
replies.body: That was definitely a big inspiration! I have over 1000 hours on both playing a20/a10. Arborist puts a twist on it that makes the challenges feel completely different.
